_comment: portfolio_analytics.json - the desk's portfolio-management configuration (Phases 1-6). Credentials are NEVER stored here. Point BLUE_PORTFOLIO_CONFIG at this file to override the defaults embedded in the module. Every block is optional; the code degrades to documented defaults when a block is absent.
_sleeves_comment: sleeve -> {bucket, beta}. 'bucket' aggregates sleeves into sectors for concentration analysis; 'beta' is the desk's assumed beta vs NIFTY, used only when no MEASURED beta is available (measured always wins, and a blend is flagged). Matching is exact-first, then rightmost-substring, so 'NIFTY IT' and 'NIFTYIT' both resolve to the IT qualifier. Keep this in sync with providers/universe.py.
_constituents_comment: LOOK-THROUGH map: sleeve -> {sector: fraction}. An index sleeve is NOT one bet. NIFTY is ~35% Financials by construction, so a 60% NIFTY sleeve is already ~21% Financials before any bank sleeve is added. Without this map a desk adds a BANKNIFTY sleeve believing it is diversifying when it is concentrating. Fractions should sum to 1.0 per sleeve; a partial map is renormalised and WARNED about, because a half-specified map silently understates every sector weight. NOTE: these are approximate, rounded, publicly-known Nifty sector weights for illustration - replace them with your own point-in-time index weights before relying on the look-through numbers.
_limits_comment: Desk risk limits (Phase 4). These are NEUTRAL DEFAULTS, not advice - set them to what your mandate and your stomach allow. max_drawdown is the hard stop: 15% needs a ~17.6% gain to recover, 25% needs ~33%. regime_overrides tighten (or loosen) limits per Economic regime, which is the single most valuable use of the macro engine.
_view_policy_comment: Phase 5 guard-rails on ML/NLP/LLM views. confidence_scale DISCOUNTS every stated confidence before max_confidence caps it (min(0.99*0.5, 0.35) = 0.35): over-confident models are the norm, and the desk pays for trusting their self-assessment. max_total_tilt bounds how far, in L1 distance, the view-implied book may differ from the view-free book. Views are OFF unless views_enabled is true.
_costs_comment: India DELIVERY cost model, bps of notional per SIDE. A round trip pays them twice: on a 10 lakh round trip at 12 bps the charges are ~534 rupees, which is why a strategy with a few-bps edge per trade inverts sign once this is applied. Override for intraday/F&O (STT differs).
_account_comment: starting_cash is the paper/backfill capital base when no live broker account is connected. capital from the broker's funds() always wins when available.
